description:
With the new framework wired and extensions migrated, delete the now-unused legacy code: opi-fin's old per-event-callback Behaviour, the Macro, the dormant Manager, the 8-pattern Dispatcher, emit_from_table, the handlers_table Context field, and the agent_supervisor/state_agent fields on API.

## Deliverable

Single Extension framework remains: OctoPi.Coder.Extension (PR #5's behaviour with on_event/3) + OctoPi.Coder.Extension.Runner + OctoPi.Coder.Extension.Loader + Host + UI + Stubs. Everything else gone.

## Steps

STEP 1 — Delete files:
  - apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/macro.ex (replaced by direct @behaviour)
  - apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/manager.ex (dead code; Session is the focal point)
  - apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/dispatcher.ex (Runner subsumes dispatch)
  - apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/behaviour.ex (replaced by the moved-from-agent OctoPi.Coder.Extension)

STEP 2 — Trim apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/api.ex:
  - Remove agent_supervisor field (api.ex:13, :25)
  - Remove state_agent field (api.ex:14, :26)
  - Remove related fns/spec changes
  - If API itself becomes vestigial, decide: keep as a minimal builder, or delete and have Loader return an Extension struct directly.

STEP 3 — Trim apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/context.ex:
  - Remove handlers_table field (context.ex:16, :32)
  - Audit other dead fields (host_pid: pid()| nil that's now superseded — confirm or remove)

STEP 4 — Delete tests for removed modules:
  - apps/octo_pi_coder/test/octo_pi/coder/extension/manager_test.exs
  - apps/octo_pi_coder/test/octo_pi/coder/extension/dispatcher_test.exs
  - apps/octo_pi_coder/test/octo_pi/coder/extension/ets_tables_test.exs
  - Any tests for the deleted Behaviour + Macro

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] These files do NOT exist:
  - apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/macro.ex
  - apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/manager.ex
- [ ] If apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/behaviour.ex exists, it's the moved one (with on_event/3), not the old per-event one. (verify content)
- [ ] If apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/dispatcher.ex exists, it's a thin internal dispatcher used by Runner (not the 8-pattern public API). Otherwise deleted.
- [ ] Context struct has no handlers_table field
- [ ] API struct has no agent_supervisor or state_agent fields
- [ ] `grep -rn "emit_from_table\|handlers_table\|agent_supervisor\|state_agent" apps/ --include="*.ex" --include="*.exs"` returns 0 matches
- [ ] No deleted-module references in tests (tests for deleted modules are themselves deleted)
- [ ] `mix test` passes
- [ ] `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` clean
- [ ] `mix credo --strict` clean

## Dependencies

Blocked by: opi-fin.17
